title: TTP Suicide VBIED Kills 2 Police at Jhungi Checkpost, Dera Ghazi Khan
detail: A TTP suicide bomber rammed an explosives-laden vehicle into the Jhungi (Hazrat Umar Farooq) Police Checkpost near Wahwa, Dera Ghazi Khan, on June 14, 2026. Two police officers, Ghulam Abbas and Mudassar Jiskani, died of their wounds; at least six more officers and roughly a dozen local civilians were injured, and nearby houses were damaged.
